rooms.hint: → next   ·   {keys} to choose   ·   Esc back to the sky
rooms.notWritten: This room is not written yet. Notes for writing it:
rooms.help: Step inside: when a star has a room, its panel shows a Step inside button (or press Enter). Inside, → shows the next line, the class chooses with A, B or C, and Esc returns to the sky.
rooms.vrHint: Trigger or A: next   ·   Point at a choice and pull the trigger   ·   B: back

chart.help: Chart it: click a star and hold for two seconds, and it drains into a checkbox. Let go early and it springs back. Double-click a charted star to restore it. For the open star, C (or the Chart it button) goes in steps: first it shows the star as it is, the next press charts it, and the record's line appears once it is a checkbox. In the headset, squeeze the grip on a star, or pinch and hold with a bare hand.
chart.vrHint: Grip on a star: chart it

dark.help: Show or hide dark matter: the nursing work that never enters the record. Point at a patch to read it. In the headset, push the thumbstick up.

vr.noHeadset: This browser has no headset attached. Open this page in the Meta Quest Browser to enter VR.
vr.notSecure: VR needs a secure address (https, or localhost). See the README section "Getting it onto the Quest".
vr.welcome: Point a controller at a star and pull the trigger to read it. Press A to start the guided tour.
vr.footerStart: Trigger: choose a star   ·   A: start the tour   ·   Trigger on empty sky: close
